nodes.name: Bridge Webhook
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 6: the session-waiter's client-tool servicing entry. The external waiter (Node, services/session-waiter) POSTs a pending client-side custom tool here; this thin wrapper delegates to the SSOT n8n handlers (Triggering Task Tail Handler / ClickUp Extract Tool Handler) and returns the user.custom_tool_result content array. headerAuth (X-Watchdog-Key, the shared waiter<->n8n key) - n8n /webhook/* is public via nginx, so this MUST be authed (the tail handler reads task data with the bot token).

nodes.name: Is extract_clickup_task?
nodes.notes: Route by tool_name: extract_clickup_task -> ClickUp Extract Tool Handler (caller-scoped REST attachment extraction); everything else (get_task_comments / get_parent_chain / list_attachments / get_attachment / get_task_details) -> Triggering Task Tail Handler. generate_image and clickup_* are in-harness MCP (ADR-055/054) and never reach here.

nodes.name: Call Extract Handler
nodes.notes: ADR-054 Block 4b ClickUp Extract Tool Handler (y985MgyA5lCxOFCH). clickup_task_id comes from the agent's tool_input (the related task it wants to read), NOT the triggering task. onError=continueErrorOutput so a failure still resolves the tool (no session deadlock).

nodes.name: Call Tail Handler
nodes.notes: Triggering Task Tail Handler (Ouo0BlYOw92DUXIh): get_task_comments / get_parent_chain / list_attachments / get_attachment / get_task_details on the triggering task. onError=continueErrorOutput so a failure still resolves the tool (no session deadlock).

nodes.name: Build Bridge Response
nodes.notes: Normalize the handler output into {tool_result_content_json, new_warnings_json}. If the handler threw (no content), build a fail-soft text result + a WARN - the waiter ALWAYS posts a tool result, so a handler failure degrades the run, never deadlocks the session. runOnceForEachItem so the 4 incoming (extract/tail x success/error) connections do NOT trigger per-connection re-runs (only the one fired branch delivers an item).

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: Return the normalized tool result to the waiter, which posts it as user.custom_tool_result and resumes the session.
